summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase workflow for Phase 21 (BYO-IPFS Node Support) to generate PLAN.md files, including research, planning, and verification steps.
summary.outcome: Phase 21 context was loaded from CONTEXT.md, the user opted to research first, and the gsd-phase-researcher agent was spawned and completed, producing 21-RESEARCH.md. The workflow was in progress (research complete, planning not yet started).

repo: Phase 21 is 'BYO-IPFS Node Support' — allows users to configure their own IPFS node for data sovereignty
Three-mode pinning model: CipherBox only / External only / Dual-pin, with client-direct architecture (no server relay)
Auth credentials stored in vault metadata on IPFS, encrypted with user key (zero-knowledge preserved)
PSA + Kubo RPC supported with auto-detection during connection test; CORS validated as part of connection test
Settings UI gets a new STORAGE tab with save/discard pattern and inline connection test
Pin migration uses TEE-based background migration with progress bar in Settings
workflow: GSD plan-phase workflow: init → validate → load context → research → plan → verify → present results
CONTEXT.md is loaded early and passed to all downstream agents (researcher, planner, checker)
Research step is interactive — user is asked whether to research before spawning the researcher agent

open_items: ROADMAP.md success criteria (SC#2, BYO-02) needs updating to reflect revised scope (three-mode pinning model + client-direct architecture instead of server-relay dual-pin)
S3-compatible storage deferred to a future phase
Provider marketplace deferred as a future UX enhancement
